AaveOracle.name: Aave Oracle (Chainlink aggregation)
AaveOracle.comment: AaveOracle.sol is part of aave-v3-core, covered by the five-firm v3 audit set plus Certora. getAssetPrice() reads a single Chainlink aggregator per asset (latestAnswer), with a fallback oracle consulted when the source is unset or returns <= 0. Price sources changeable only by governance-controlled ASSET_LISTING/POOL_ADMIN roles. Secures Aave v3 ($12.08B TVL, DefiLlama 2026-07-02), which LiquidityPoolAave depends on for health-factor and LTV checks.

PaxosOracle.name: PaxosOracle (hardcoded 1:1 for Paxos stablecoins)
PaxosOracle.comment: Sprinter's own contracts/PaxosOracle.sol values USDG and PYUSD at an immutable 1:1 to USDC, so the real dependency is Paxos as issuer and peg-maintainer - a depeg is NOT reflected by this oracle (oracleDependency 4). Paxos token stack audited by Trail of Bits, Zellic and Halborn (audits 2). Both tokens are proxy-upgradeable by Paxos multisigs with no documented timelock, and Paxos holds pause plus ASSET_PROTECTION_ROLE freeze/wipe power over any holder including our pools (centralization 4). PYUSD live since 2023-08-07; USDG since 2024-11-01, ~20 months, which sets longevity (2). Market caps: USDG $3.01B, PYUSD $2.75B (CoinGecko 2026-07-02). Issuers are NYDFS- (Paxos Trust) and MAS-regulated (Paxos Digital Singapore) with monthly reserve attestations.
